title: What if the Sun vanished right now? ☀️
subject: sun
description:
Would you survive down there? 👇

What would happen to Earth if the Sun disappeared? It starts with an 8-minute delay and ends deep under the ice.

Sources: NASA, Live Science

scenes.text: If the Sun vanished, you wouldn't notice for 8 minutes.
That's how long its light and even its gravity take to reach us, and then Earth flies off in a straight line into the dark.
The sky goes black, and the Moon disappears with it.
Within a year, the surface drops to minus 100 degrees and the oceans freeze from the top down.
